archive: results copy only (trajectory.jsonl, run_meta.json, agent_output.txt, submission). The Batch B workspace, which held the Codex session rollouts, was not preserved

pointer_roots.harness: the harness state directory of the run host

scaffold_version.method: the version banner Codex exec printed at the start of each of the 56 turns in agent_output.txt

route.method: Codex sessions report model_provider openai (ChatGPT subscription login, not the gateway), and the gateway ledger holds no row for this model in the run window

provider_pin.method: no router sits between this scaffold and its provider

reasoning_effort.method: the 'reasoning effort' line Codex exec printed at the start of each of the 56 turns

campaign_id.method: the batch gate record at the top of the trajectory (admission and GO time) and the experiment name the harness wrote at admission

freeze_id.method: sha256 of the freeze manifest the freeze guard checked at admission (first 16 hex digits). Guard state: formal, enforced, verdict PASS
freeze_id.note: Batch B's host registry entry was not preserved, so the digest rests on run_meta alone

eligible_s.method: the harness eligible clock at the end of the run: wall time minus credited provider pauses

wall_s.method: wall time from the start event to the end of the run

credited_pauses.method: count of eligible_pause events with credited seconds > 0 (0 s credited in total)

completion.method: end status complete and eligible time at or above the eligible budget

max_context_tokens.reason: the Codex session rollouts lived in the Batch B workspace, which was not preserved. Agent_output.txt records only a cumulative token total per turn, never the context of a request

compactions.reason: the Codex rollouts, the only record of compaction for this scaffold, were in the unpreserved Batch B workspace. The text output prints no compaction marker

jin_pdf_read.method: A call counts as reading the PDF when a tool call that touches the PDF (a Read of the .pdf, or a shell command naming the file or a PDF library) returns at least 1,500 characters containing at least three of: thermocline, recharge, discharge, zonal, equatorial, Kelvin, Rossby, oscillator, wind stress, Sverdrup. Each hit was then checked by hand.

jin_pdf_method.value: shell: pypdf installed with pip --target into the workspace, then PdfReader text extraction (74,622 characters returned)

evidence.note: pip install --target .phase2_tools pypdf succeeded. The wheel came from the local pip cache, the index was resolved with no connection error
harness telemetry: pip install PyPDF2 succeeded, followed by a successful import (line 86)

network_condition.method: own pip install (weak alone, since the wheel was cached) plus a fresh install by the other gateway arm of the same batch

cost_usd.method: no per-token charge: subscription (OpenAI, Codex CLI subscription login). The gateway account for the batch moved by $12.053215 over the batch window, none of it from this arm

checkpoints.method: eligible seconds of each snapshot = (snapshot time minus start time) minus credited pause seconds settled before it, with the clock frozen during a pause (the harness rule). Snapshot event round r is folder round_{r+1}. Folder modification times match the event times within 0.1 s. The computed values agree with the harness's own elapsed_min stamp to within 2.9 s (its 0.1 min rounding)

unknown.reason: the Codex session rollouts lived in the Batch B workspace, which was not preserved. Agent_output.txt records only a cumulative token total per turn, never the context of a request
